[quote=tirakan;60750453][b]Official Communiqué - Free Republic of Naerim
To the free Governments and People of Erene [/b]

Honoured Leaders, Allies, and Partners in the Pursuit of Peace,

The Free Republic of Naerim addresses you today as East Shamats last resort against tyranny and bloodshed.
Our land, once a part of Tirakan, now bears the full weight of two collapsing orders, the militarist Renaissance Union and the theocratic Holy League. Both are determined to erase every voice that speaks for liberty, knowledge, and human dignity. They harass our borders whilst we not only defend our, and those of our precious allies in the Coastal Alliance, but also the seas together with brave soldiers of [nation]Valodya[nation], to allow safe trade across the Shamat Sea, where we supply many of your households with cheap gas.

But the Unions of Evil within Tirakan? They call their wars reunification and purification. We call them what they are, the sadistic tyrannts aiming to destroy civilisation.
Our cities are shelled. Our capital has been bombed. Our Premier, Kareth Onu, was murdered by suicide attackers only days ago. We've called out to them to bring more, as yet still, we stand.

We reach out today to the independent governments and free peoples of [nation]Baladullah[nation], [nation]Vespurias[nation], [nation]Skullsbrough[nation], [nation]Karcovshkie[/nation], [nation]Greater Rostoria[nation], [nation]Neue Republik[nation], [nation]Cervantasdill[nation], [nation]Italian Dutch[nation] and [nation]Hyunseo[nation], not as beggars, but as survivors of fanatism, tyranny and despotic megalomaniacal dictators.

Naerim is fighting for a free and plural Tirakan, one where no crown or creed dictates the worth of a person. But ideals alone cannot stop bullets, nor feed the families living beneath the whistling sound of death on artillery fields.
We therefore call for immediate assistance from your nations, each of which understands that it will take all of you to achieve more than just mere armistice.
Today we require, arms, defensive technology, manpower, training assistance, humanitarian aid, and tomorrow, when we step forth as victors over the illegitimate crown, it will be re-construction material and financial aid to rebuild the once been trade axis and resourceful paradise of the Shamat and North Sea, that many of us used to profit from shaking hands with.
It will be the technology, developed through our despair in war, joint construction contracts, open trade, harbor shares, gas and regional stability that will serve not only you but the greater good of Erene.

Naerim fights not to expand, but to survive the repeated attacks on our sovereignty.
If we fall, there will be no free coast left in Tirakan, no line of resistance to stand between tyranny, the sea and you.

The war is no longer local. It is the front line between progress and civilian massacre.
Let us join hands, and the dictators will creep forwards, as theres a gun in the back of their head.

[b]A morgna ves core. Vectern sis da[/b].

[i]Arlen Vos, Acting Premier of the Free Republic of Naerim[/i]

---- Additional Pings ----
[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
[nation]Valddera[/nation]
[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP[/quote]

OFFICIAL STATEMENT OF THE COMMONWEALTH OF KARCOVSHKIE

Issued by Order of the National Council

The Commonwealth of Karcovshkie addresses the peoples of the East Shamat region in a moment of uncertainty. From east to west, the lands around us fracture beneath the weight of tyranny, famine, fanaticism, and the uncontrolled ambitions of those who claim dominion but offer only suffering.

To the Free Republic of Naerim, whose people endure bombardment, starvation, and relentless assault, we acknowledge your suffering. Your struggle against despotism and zealotry has not gone unnoticed within the halls of our council. While the lands of Tirakan break under the weight of their own history, it is Naerims citizens who carry the burden of defending what remains of stability on our shared frontier.

We recognize that if Naerim falls entirely into chaos, the consequences will not stop at your borders. It will spread to the coasts, to the ports, to the trade routes, and to every nation that depends on the balance of the region. We cannot and will not permit the rise of unchecked tyranny or the spread of ideologies that prey upon civilians, annihilate order, or threaten the security of our homeland.

To those who endure hardship and violence in Naerim, we offer our acknowledgment, our respect, and the assurance that Karcovshkie will not stand idle as the region collapses around you. Strength is needed, and strength we shall provide. The Commonwealth will provide older model tanks, armored personnel carriers, utility vehicles, and small arms to strengthen the ability of Naerims forces to defend their people. Additionally, shipments of food, clean water, and medical supplies will be provided to sustain civilians and frontline defenders alike. 

Beyond material support, selected personnel from Naerim will be invited to Karcovshkie for specialized training in defensive operations, emergency medical care, and logistical coordination. In doing so, we hope this conflict will soon be quelled and for the Free Republic of Naerim to prosper. 

The Commonwealth stands with Naerim

Issued by the National Council of the Commonwealth of Karcovshkie
Velzograd, Karcovshkie

By Order of Head of State Mikhail Ardeyenko

Approved by The MIR Council

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60756807][b]December 10-20, 2026: The Federation[/b][/quote]
[spoiler=[b]Citharo the Beautiful[/b]][b]Citharo the Beautiful[/b]

After the revolution, the old gives way to the new. It's why people presume the architect of socialist states to be miserable, imaged as lines of concrete boxes through the grey jungle, sometimes decrepit, unsuitable for human habitation. But these same boxes are often utilitarian, which provided men and women with inexpensive housing, and often state-subsidized under the fundamental rights guaranteed by most socialist governments. However, perhaps as an indication of its sheer ideological immensity, what greeted you in Citharo was not the utilitarian housing of the new but instead the ornaments and beauty of the old, dressed in marble and limestone and with gilded carvings resting on warm Marisalbic sunlight.

"City Beautiful", as the Vespurian architects would call it.

Enter through the port and walk along the pier, and you'll be met by the "Twelve Apostles", twelve great roads that form along the Cisalpine Highway leading deeper into Citharo's center, each one leading visitors through a different aspect of city life. Along San Filippo's, for example, would be the oldest shops in the city, some with a legacy going back to the Vallist Kingdom, and which leads directly towards the great Alpine Highway that guided travelers to the capital city of Ventusia. In San Simone, there are a row of old entertainment buildings once known for its gambling and gentleman's clubs, though these had long since been converted into multi-purpose halls instead for various community events. 

The Thyvenic delegation would be driven through the sixth street, Sant'Andrea, where St. Andrew's crosses and saltires appear prominently throughout the stuccoworks that lined its high-rise buildings. A few landmarks are seen here and there, such as the prominent [i]Ciotola d'oro[/i] hotel, the [i]San Michele Confessore[/i] building, the "King Fir" tree that acted as a natural separator for private and public buildings, and last but not least the [i]Municipio[/i], the seat of Citharo's local government and, nowadays, the [i]de facto[/i] meeting place of the Socialist International (who [i]de jure[/i] are supposed to use the nearby building instead, San Martino's.

"Yo."

A strange woman wearing thick black sunglasses greeted the limousine as it parked to the side of the Municipio. In her hand was a thick set of papers stapled poorly together, seemingly done with great difficult, for the corners of the documents had been haphazardly crimpled perhaps during the effort. It was Immacolata Terrasi, one of Socialist International's foremost economic experts. Why she was standing outside without ceremony or guards, and holding on to what seemed to be a very important reports, only God seems to know. Judging by the lack of the crowd, it seems that the Sanguinians declined to make the meeting publicly-known too, and it seems the domestic media narrative had been focused almost entirely on keeping track of the Thyvenic Revolution [i]beyond[/i] the nation's borders.

"Thyven delegation, welcome to Citharo!" Terrasi loudly proclaimed, crossing her arms and damaging her report even further. "Good morning, good morning! I am Immocolata Terrasi, I was sent here by the Presidium to meet with you all. You're walking on Socialism's most Holy land, so make sure to bask in the atmosphere! C'mon, follow me, we can talk about things inside."

Before the Thyvenic delegation could even introduce themselves, Terrasi suddenly turned around and began marching into the Municipio, the two Red Guards meekly opening the doors for her as though she were a member of the party elite, and she was, though she didn't seem the slightest bit concerned about presenting herself in that way.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]One Shamat?[/b]
[i]geographically we are two separate landmasses, ethnically we are thousands of different groups, but ideologically we stand as ONE![/i]]

Pan-Shamatism. It was a broad term, yet one that also had a definite impact. It brought people together, yet it could also tear them apart. It empowered people beyond their known limits, whilst sending shivers down the spines of others. The idea had been born in Sikirsk and spread into Hydronia during Erenes coldest times, but had since grown dormant and somewhat forgotten as support dwindled.

That was until recently.

The Hydronian government, whether it be under the conservatives or the socialists, had been unable to please the people as of late. The military had once again been dragged into a war against a terrorist grout on the other side of the continent, the situation in Tallisland didnt seem to be improving and Hydronia had seemingly become weaker and weaker on the world stage. Protests had increased across several states, such as North Bugostan, Hadabir, Bahral, Yukesal, Esperia and even the capital state, Hydropolis, which had been starkly in favour of the SUP during both the original elections for 2026 and during the subsequent reelection and brief Hydronian political crisis. One group had risen to the forefront of these protests, and that was the Hydronian Union of Pan-Shamatists.

The HUPS, founded in 1979, had long gone underrepresented and ignored by Hydronia as a whole. They had never held a seat in the parliamentary assembly, nor had they ever managed to pitch a candidate up for election in any Hydronian state. But today, that would change.

The HUPS has managed to remain internally active and stable, despite never finding any mainstream popularity. Leadership elections had continued to be held, but none of the chairmen had ever done anything differently, until this years elections. Durul Kuznetsov, the newly elected chairman, was a mixed Hydronian-Sikirskian. He had long harboured ideas of a united shamat and had joined the HUPS at age 27. Whilst the first half of his leadership this year had seemed to remain the same as every other, things would begin to change around December-time. The Sikirskian elections, as well as the recent failures by the government, in his eyes, would prompt Durul to push forward his plan for the HUPS and its future. It began with protests and rallies across the country.

These protests were mainly concentrated in the state of Bahral. This state had remained fairly conservative throughout Hydronias history, whilst remaining open for change. These were the perfect conditions for the HUPS to gain traction with the people, and so they did. As the rallies began to get larger and larger, President Bozkan would become increasingly worried, but the right to free speech and lack of violence at these protests meant that the Federal Government couldnt do anything about it.

The weeks would go on, with almost daily rallies across Hydronia, lead by the HUPS, but this wasnt Duruls only idea. The public support wasnt enough, they had to get candidates up for election in 2027-2028. With funding from public donors, as well as alledged funding from their Sikirskian pan-shamatist counterparts, HUPS candidates would become eligible in the states of  Bahral, Yukesal, Hadabir, Koimir, Esperia, Telvira, Kalvedira and Turvekistan, in time for the next federal elections.

Now Durul had secured a future for the HUPS in Hydronia, he would begin to turn out his more radical ideas to the rest of the HUPS board. The northern federation was a name that came up a lot. Durul would propose a future goal for the HUPS, and that would be unity with Sikirsk to form a joint Hydro-Sikirskian state. This theoretical state would act as a confederate union between the two nations at first, with more and more unity being implemented across a span of 10 years. But, however glorious this state may be, in Duruls mind it served as only a stepping stone to the true shamatine dream. The goal of the northern federation would ultimately be to unite the rest of shamat, through any means necessary. Beginning with the bordering states of Alaqar and Tarzania in East shamat, whilst working to remove Jomsland and SummitONE from west shamat. It was certainly a very long-term idea, but it was an idea nonetheless.

Whilst this ideas would begin to form in the leadership of the HUPS, rallies and protests would start to die down (much to the relief of the Hydronian government). With candidates ready and public support secured, it would simply be a waiting game for the pan-shamatists of Hydronia.

The movement had certainly shaken the country, but could it seize the country?[/spoiler]
